newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean and soymeal shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean and soymeal shipping conditions.

text.p: Following is an update of shipping conditions for Brazilian soybeans and soymeal detailing ships loading, waiting to dock or expected, warehouse stocks and arrivals on Feb 25/26 at the ports of Santos, Paranagua and Sao Francisco do Sul.
Two vessels loading soymeal. Two expected (one soymeal, one soybeans).
Warehouse stocks 21,200 tonnes soybeans, 5,600 t soymeal. By road, 228 trucks arrived carrying soybeans. By rail, 12 wagons soymeal.
Three vessels loading soymeal, 13 waiting to load (eight soymeal, five soybeans). One expected (soymeal).
By road, 356 trucks arrived carrying soybeans, 170 trucks soymeal. A total of 2,400 trucks soybeans so far in February. By rail, 212 wagons soybeans, 123 wagons soymeal (*).
Feb 28, one vessel to load 20,000 t soymeal.
Mar 3, one vessel to load 30,000 t soymeal.
Mar 4, one vessel to load soymeal.
Mar 6, one vessel to load 30,000 t soymeal.
Mar 10, one vessel to load 30,000 t soymeal.
Warehouse stocks at least 30,000 t soymeal, no soybeans.
By rail, 160 to 180 wagons of soymeal arriving per day. By road, very few trucks.
* Wagons capacity of 40,000 to 45,000 t each, trucks 30,000 t
